$comment: What a skill run may do, and who may order one. Read by run_request.py when an order is placed (orderable_by) and by runner.py when it executes (the rest). No policy at the pipeline root: nothing is ordered and nothing runs. `default` applies where a skill says nothing; a skill lists only what differs. Paths: {data} is the pipeline root, {container} the ordered container. `agent` is the name (from people.json) the headless session works and signs as. `model` is handed to the session as --model; a skill that writes text runs on Opus, a skill that checks runs on Sonnet (Chris, 2026-10-13); without the field Claude Code's default applies.

interpret.$comment: Produces the container's deliverables and may move it a stage — the whole pipeline root is writable; python3 for the production scripts; the web for the fact-checker.

canonical-review.$comment: Evaluates a published piece and writes its verdict into the container. Reads the canon, writes one folder.

reflect.$comment: Turns an observation into a signal container in 05-operational-observations.

asset.$comment: Dormant since 2026-09-06 — visuals are made elsewhere. Nobody may order it until that changes.

derive.$comment: Derives the remaining deliverables from a human-written primary artifact; never rewrites it. Same rights as interpret.
